classifications.rationale: The President reports to Congress that he previously issued an executive order; this segment does not itself expand the emergency or alter legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order

classifications.rationale: The President describes to Congress the legal effects, delegation, and implementation directions contained in a separately issued order and encloses it; this reporting segment itself creates no legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: I am enclosing a copy of the Executive Order I have issued.
